items.title: George Pickens: Gets into end zone in win
items.text:
Pickens brought in four of six targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

items.title: Javonte Williams: Career-high rushing yardage in win
items.text:
Williams rushed 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

items.title: Dak Prescott: Trio of TDs in Week 7 win
items.text:
Prescott completed 15 of 27 passes for 212 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for eight yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night. He also had a two-point conversion run.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb: Another pair of TDs in win
items.text:
